name: United Faith Auto-Engineering Co., Ltd.
summary: United Faith Auto-Engineering Co., Ltd. is dedicated to the creation, manufacturing, and distribution of advanced industrial automation solutions. This includes the entire lifecycle of integrated automation products, intelligent production equipment, smart assembly units, and their corresponding parts, from design and development to fabrication and final assembly. The company’s specialized offerings cater to a diverse range of sectors, such as the automotive industry, electronic appliances, heavy machinery, and railway systems. Founded in 2005 and based in Guangzhou, China, its business operations span a global footprint, encompassing markets in China, Japan, various Southeast Asian countries, and both North and South America.
